title: The Last Dragon Smith
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The last dragon-smith, old Bryn, can forge a dragon\'s heart from iron and fire — a heart that beats once a century. When the kingdom\'s final dragon dies, Bryn is ordered to forge a new one, but the heart he forges beats with a will of its own: it chooses its bearer, and it chooses Bryn\'s granddaughter.
